title: Moon and Mars Gravity
body: The Moon has mass $$7.35\times10**{22}\,\text{kg}$$ and radius $$1.74\times10**{6}\,\text{m}$$. $$The$$ $$mass$$ $$of$$ $$Mars$$ $$is$$ $$6.418\times10**{23}\,\text{kg}$$ and its radius is $$3.38\times10**{6}\,\text{m}$$. $$Take$$ G=$$6.674\times10**{-11}\,\tfrac{\text{N}\cdot\text{m}**2}{\text{kg}**2}$$.
